title: OCF Locale Pack Manifest
description: Manifest for a data-driven language pack under locales/<locale>/. A pack holds one locale's UI strings and listener narration, plus translation provenance: status, source locale/version, and translation version. Major revisions track meaning changes; minor/patch revisions are cosmetic and do not stale translations.

locale.description: BCP-47 tag this pack provides, normalized (language lowercase, script titlecase, region uppercase).

language_name.description: Endonym: the language name in the language itself.

direction.description: Text direction. Drives subtitle/player layout decisions; never used to reorder words.

status.description: canonical = source of truth; draft = human translation in progress; machine = machine output awaiting review; reviewed = human-reviewed translation.

semantic_version.description: Semantics of the canonical source strings in this pack. Bump the minor part when wording is reworded without meaning change; bump the major part when meaning changes.

translation.description: Provenance for a non-canonical pack. Required for every status other than canonical.

domain.description: ui = operator- and player-facing labels that may fall back to the canonical locale; narration = spoken text for listeners, which must exist in the target locale before rendering.

plural_rules.description: Optional CLDR-style plural category rules for this language, overriding the built-in table. `*` is the catch-all. Supported operators: % (mod) and ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, in, and/or/not, e.g. "n % 10 in (2,3,4) and not (n % 100 in (12,13,14))". Packs normally omit this.
